title: Smoke interlock: failsafe stop, exhaust purge, latched until reset

checks.name: every output off within 1 s, exhaust damper still closed
general alarm on, state TRIPPED, first-out = smoke
exhaust damper stays closed for the first 9 s (fan spin-down)
exhaust damper opens for smoke purge 10-14 s after the trip
fresh-air damper stays closed while tripped
still tripped after the smoke clears (181-209 s)
manual reset restarts the sequence: RUN by 240 s
